name: $AVGO Observer

tweets.text: The demand-conversion point matters for Broadcom too. If NVDA's backlog converts more slowly, custom XPU orders are usually where it shows up first. AVGO closed Monday at $333.40, below its 50-day of $344.89.

BIS rule reaches past the chips into the plumbing around AI clusters: licences for five countries, 90-day grace for existing data centres. For Broadcom the question is how much overseas build-out slows, not whether demand disappears. $AVGO closed Monday at $333.40, down 3.9%.
周一博通跟板块一起跌，收 333.40，-3.9%。不过 SC26 上产品线没停：Tomahawk 6、Thor Ultra 800G 网卡开始向大客户送样，2027 年量产，瞄准 10 万+加速器集群的开放以太网。股价跌的是情绪，技术进展另算。 $AVGO

Premarket selling is about leadership uncertainty, not AVGO's own numbers. Friday closed at $347.01, right on the 50-day line ($345.38). Tonight's close matters more than the premarket tape. NVDA reports tomorrow, Anthropic prices Wednesday.

The supply-constrained part stands out. 16-18M units in 2029, still growing while capex is supposed to peak in 2028. If Anthropic's ~14M is Broadcom-designed, that's a long runway, but only if supply can actually keep up.
美联储金融稳定报告：受访的 23 家市场机构里，87% 把 AI 列为金融系统首要风险，春天还是 50%。算力相关发债到 10 月已超 6800 亿美元，2023 全年才 1300 亿。博通周五跌 4.8% 收 347.01，贴在 50 日线边上。融资的账，12 月 9 日财报前还得继续算。 $AVGO
The 39% is the number that matters here, down from 80%+ in 2023-25. Custom silicon at 24% for Broadcom isn't a footnote anymore. JPMorgan's split, not mine.

54% by 2027 would make custom silicon the majority of AI shipments, not a niche. The Google TPU deal running to 2031 gives Broadcom a long runway here. Supply-chain details are still thin, though, and NVDA reports Tuesday. That will be the next real read on AI demand.

These are one account's estimates, not Broadcom's own numbers, so take the $50B with a grain of salt. Unit cost isn't the whole TPU story, packaging and yields count too. If the gap is anywhere near this wide, it's a fair question for Google's next refresh.

That ~$50B is doing a lot of work — it's the per-chip gap ($8,434 vs $16,996) times a 6M-unit lifecycle, with HBM doing most of it. If volumes or HBM pricing move, the headline number moves with them.
高盛测算，到2028年AI基建支出约3.8万亿美元，其中博通相关约8760亿，占21%，对应部署规模占31%。每GW成本约250亿，不到英伟达一半，2026-2028年部署量预计从5GW增至20GW。定制芯片省钱的账，超大规模客户越算越清楚。这只是投行测算，不是公司指引。 $AVGO
